Metadata.title: InviteFlow — Elegant Digital Invitations
Metadata.description: Elegant digital invitations with instant WhatsApp RSVP confirmation — for occasions that deserve the details done right.

hero.subtitle: Design your digital invitation and share it with your guests in minutes — simple, and fully professional.
hero.guestLink: Or try it as a guest, no sign-up ←

trustStrip.item1Label: Guests never open a separate link
trustStrip.item3Label: One tap to respond, right in WhatsApp
trustStrip.item4Label: Your data is protected in the database

why.title: Why InviteFlow?
why.statement: Built from the ground up for Arabic-speaking users — not a translated foreign tool.
why.point1: Guests reply right inside WhatsApp — never opening a link at all
why.point2: An elegant digital invitation you share with one link
why.point3: Every guest gets their own edit link, no account needed
why.point4: Your data is protected by row-level security in the database

invitation.title: Digital invitation
invitation.description: A simple personal invitation to an occasion (wedding, graduation...) — optional accept/decline, no extra questions.

rsvp.title: Link Invitation
rsvp.description: A direct registration link — name, phone, headcount, and your own questions. Ideal when you need accurate numbers fast, without an invitation design.

institutional.title: Institutional invitation
institutional.description: For a company or organization: your name and logo appear on the invitation, with your own custom design if you have one.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.hint: An automatic WhatsApp message to confirmed guests — one day before the event and one day after. You can cancel either before it goes out.

bulkMessage.title: Bulk message to confirmed guests
bulkMessage.description: Sends a WhatsApp message directly to every guest who replied "attending" only — good for last-minute updates (a venue or time change) that don’t apply to everyone invited.

addGuests.title: Add guests
addGuests.description: Paste your whole list at once — we’ll review it with you before saving.
addGuests.pasteListPlaceholder:
One guest per line, e.g.:
Sultan Alharbi 0501234567
Nora Alotaibi, 0559876543
Abdullah	+966551112233
addGuests.pasteListHint: Copy from Excel, Notes, or anywhere — any separator between name and number. Arabic-Indic digits are read automatically.
addGuests.companionsHint: The organizer's estimate — replaced by the guest's own answer once they reply.
addGuests.reviewDescription: Check the names and numbers, and drop any row you don’t want. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
addGuests.contactsUnsupported: Picking contacts directly works on Android/Chrome only. On iPhone: export your contacts as a VCF file, or paste the list above.
